name: bar-chart
purpose: Accessible SVG bar and column chart for comparing values across categories: vertical or horizontal, grouped or stacked, with negative values, gaps, optional value labels, a toggleable legend, keyboard-reachable bars with tooltips, a generated summary, and a data table fallback.
whenToUse: Stacked: showing totals and their composition.
Horizontal: long category labels or many categories.
whenNotToUse: Trends over continuous time: use Line Chart.
A single part-to-whole breakdown with few parts: Pie Chart may read faster.
Exact lookup of many values: use Data Table.
responsive: Width follows the container (ResizeObserver); height is the height option. Category labels are truncated or thinned to fit; horizontal charts reserve at most 40% of the width for labels. Reflows at 320 CSS px.
rtl: direction rtl mirrors the category axis of vertical charts and the value axis of horizontal charts (bars grow leftward), puts axis labels on the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.
theme: Bars use color-chart-1..8 by palette slot with a color-surface separator; textures are drawn in color-surface. Gridlines color-chart-grid, axes color-chart-axis, labels color-text-muted, value labels color-text with a color-surface halo. Forced colors use CanvasText, Canvas, and Highlight.
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; sizes and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: BarChart.create, 50 categories x 4 series (grouped and stacked), including the first render
budgets.budget: < 30 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test, median of 5)

performance.testedScale: Up to about 200 bars at once (each bar is one focusable node plus one texture overlay). For hundreds of categories, aggregate first or use a Data Table.

limitations: Every series needs exactly one value per category.
A fixed valueAxis domain clips bars at its edges.
Value labels in stacked charts are printed only in segments large enough for them.
unsupported: Percent-stacked (100%) layout, bullet, waterfall, and combo charts.
antiPatterns: Truncating the value axis (valueAxis.min above zero) for bars.
More than about 8 series per category.
Relying on color alone by turning patterns off for grouped series.
